focus_tree = {
	id = swedish_focus
	country = {
		factor = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			tag = SWE
		}
	}
	shared_focus = SHARED_root
	# A comment with a brace in it: {
	focus = {
		id = SWE_expand_industry
		x = 1
		y = 0
		completion_reward = {
			add_ideas = "SWE_#_not_a_comment"
		}
	}
	focus = {
		id = SWE_civilian_industry
		prerequisite = { focus = SWE_expand_industry }
	}
	focus = {
		id = SWE_arms_industry
		# OR: either prerequisite will do
		prerequisite = { focus = SWE_civilian_industry focus = SWE_expand_industry }
	}
	focus = {
		id = SWE_modern_army
		# AND: both groups must be met
		prerequisite = { focus = SWE_civilian_industry }
		prerequisite = { focus = SWE_arms_industry }
		available = { num_of_factories > 20 }
	}
}
